name: Maiya
source:
Department of Robotics (specialty in operation); Fainting goat

An undergrad who enjoys shouting things like 'bullet barrage' and 'final combined push approved!' She goes as stiff as a board when surprised.

She wants to control a space battleship or a giant robot, but such things don't exist in this world yet.
